context: Cloudflare Turnstile documents three widget modes per https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/: managed (Cloudflare decides when to show a challenge), non-interactive (always shows a non-interactive challenge) and invisible (mounts an invisible widget). The choice is a per-surface operational profile.
decision: Widget mode is elicited (elicited: true). Values: managed, non-interactive, invisible. recommendedDefault: managed. The applied-sidecar records the operator answer per applying surface. Standards trace clause: Cloudflare Turnstile documented widget modes.
consequences: The elicitation forces an explicit answer on every apply. The pack fixture accepts mode=managed, non-interactive or invisible and pins the invisible-widget test sitekeys (1x0000000000000000000000BB, 2x0000000000000000000000BB) alongside the managed pass/fail sitekeys so every mode is exercised.
title: Widget mode is an elicited enum {managed, non-interactive, invisible}; recommendedDefault managed
